steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Vigilante 8 Arcade Xbox 360 XBLA package or its complete extracted files. Title 584108A8.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Run Setup.cmd with your own Vigilante 8 package. It downloads the compiler and SDK, then generates and builds the Windows runtime locally.
